verdict.rationale: Ollama clearly runs a range of open models. The evidence shows Gemma 4 from its library, a hands-on run of the MoE model qwen3.5:35b-a3b, working multimodal support in the app, local image generation on macOS, and pulling new models from Hugging Face or the Ollama registry with one command. Nothing in the pack documents embedding models or the breadth of 'hundreds of architectures'. missing for 10: documented embedding-model support, evidence of hundreds of supported architectures, a first-party model/architecture support list, explicit MoE documentation.
